digest.component_or_area: code review impact model (code-v3 to code-v4 redesign)
propositions: The code-v3 impact model discards verifier-provided prod_impact and trigger_likelihood for maint-lane test findings, preventing code review from blocking consequential test-sufficiency gaps
Commit 8eadb4fbc5 shipped a contract allowing stale>0 while a co-shipped test asserted stale=0, creating an undetected contradiction because the tests antipattern lacked a contract-contradiction rule

Code-v4 introduces a new binary forbids_contract_allowed_state with verbatim evidence requirements and tightening guards, re-scopes prod_impact/trigger_likelihood to rate guarded-path user reach rather than file type, and implements lane-split impact multipliers (serious undamped, moderate prod-keyed, debt amplifier-only)
Tests findings threshold moves from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.54 under code-v4, increasing blocking changes from 42 (3.4%) to 99 (8.0%) with zero demotions of currently-blocking findings
Reversibility floor is restricted to consequence lanes only (requires consequence base>0 and hard_to_reverse_surface), preventing debt-only binaries from incorrectly reaching blocking threshold

Replay verification confirms stored code-v3 sidecars remain unmodified and version-gated; v4 off-line analysis reproduces 163/99 blocking set with 1120/1664 internal-edge test findings correctly staying advisory
